fusions.name: Mangrove Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps onto one enemy and rolls it under for 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Mangrove roots hold it [Caged] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Surfacing Snap
fusions.desc: You burst from cover up to 6 tiles to your target and snap across a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mudbank Rest
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Log in the Reeds
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. You also regenerate 1 health a second.
